$Comment: What each of the host's first three quests pays. Every roll is read on its own: the first always
pays, the second is a chance on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
The first roll pays festival tokens, the currency every season shares, through the Currency reward
kind (a counter wallet has no item to hand over), with a couple of loaves for the road. Favor with
the host and Festival Favor are not here: each quest pays them on its own Rewards, so the quest card
shows them. A companion mod adds rolls of its own with a file that names this table in
ContributesTo, so nothing here has to change.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Chain_Pay
